opening.argument: The video presents a branded spoken explanation of why traditional finance and decentralized finance use Chainlink, centered on CCIP adoption, security, reliability, and infrastructure. Its central rationale is that “CCIP is the chosen technology” because of “the security and the reliability,” while the speaker describes the broader objective as creating “this reliable, scalable infrastructure.” Those favorable statements, along with the claim that “CCIP powered bridges continue to operate without issue,” are promotional assertions about technology adoption and performance, but they remain part of an operational and educational discussion. Nothing described directs viewers to send money, provide credentials, or join an investment opportunity, so the material does not establish a scam-oriented solicitation.

citations.quote: Why TradFi & DeFi Use Chainlink | Sergey Nazarov
CCIP is the chosen technology for the same reason that other chain link technologies like the data technologies are the chosen technologies, which is the security and the reliability.
This is really what the focus of the chain in the community is to create this reliable, scalable infrastructure
CCIP powered bridges continue to operate without issue.
